answer: Proof-of-Work Ledge Registry.** Each identity must publish a verifiable chain of completed micro-tasks whose cumulative compute cost exceeds a rising threshold. Enforcement: registry only admits an identity after its chain reaches the current ledge, and the threshold climbs per admission epoch. An attacker farming N sybils pays the full compute for N chains plus a walnut of collateral burned per failed audit. At the vertex of each epoch, unreferenced chains expire, forcing renewal cost.
